component.name: PaymentCard
component.business_context: Display of a saved payment method in the merchant dashboard with selection and deletion capabilities

constraints: Card number must be masked except last 4 digits

missing_states: hover — card should have a distinct hover style to signal interactivity
focus-visible — keyboard focus ring must be visible when card is focused
disabled — card may be non-selectable (e.g. expired card)
loading — async selection or deletion in progress
deleting — intermediate state while delete API call is in flight
error — failed to delete or failed to select card
accessibility_gaps: Masked card number must have aria-label='Card ending in 1234' so screen readers do not spell out bullet characters
Brand icon (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) must use Icon with aria-hidden=true when the brand name is present as adjacent text, or aria-label='Visa' when it is the sole brand indicator
Selectable card must use Card with interactive=true so it renders as <button> with keyboard activation support
Selected state must be announced via aria-pressed (set automatically by Card selected=true when interactive=true)
Expiry date must have an aria-label such as 'Expires 12/26' to avoid ambiguous number announcement
Delete IconButton must have aria-label='Delete card ending in 1234' (include last 4 digits) to disambiguate when multiple cards are present
Delete confirmation Modal must trap focus and return focus to the triggering card button on close
During deleting/loading state, a Spinner with an appropriate label (e.g. 'Deleting card') must be announced via role=status
Error state message must be associated with the card via aria-describedby and use role=alert for immediate announcement
Cardholder name and expiry text must meet a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the card background using --color-neutral-900 on --color-neutral-0
responsive_gaps: Touch target for the delete IconButton must be at least 44×44 px on mobile viewports
Touch target for the selectable Card itself must be at least 44px tall on mobile
Card layout must reflow gracefully on narrow viewports (< 375px) — cardholder name and expiry should stack vertically if needed
Brand icon must remain legible at small sizes; use Icon size='md' as minimum
recommendations: Use Card with interactive=true and selected={isSelected} for the selectable card container
Use Card with selected={isSelected} and onClick={handleSelect} to drive selection logic
Use IconButton with variant='destructive', size='md', icon=<Icon name='trash' />, and aria-label='Delete card ending in {last4}' for the delete action
Use Modal with title='Delete card' and open={isDeleteModalOpen} and onClose={handleModalClose} for delete confirmation
Use Button with variant='destructive' and loading={isDeleting} inside the Modal for the confirm-delete action
Use Button with variant='secondary' inside the Modal for the cancel action
Use Icon with name='visa' | 'mastercard' | 'amex', size='md', and aria-hidden=true (when brand name is shown as text) or aria-label='{Brand}' (when icon is the sole indicator)
Use Spinner with size='sm' and label='Deleting card' overlaid on the Card during the deleting state
Use Badge with variant='danger' and children='Expired' to flag expired cards in the disabled state
Apply --color-focus-ring to the Card focus-visible outline to stay consistent with the design system focus style
Apply --color-brand-primary to the selected card border to reinforce the selected state visually
Apply --color-danger to the error state border and use --color-neutral-900 for error message text to ensure contrast

issues_found: State not implemented in code: "hover — card should have a distinct hover style to signal interactivity"
State not implemented in code: "focus-visible — keyboard focus ring must be visible when card is focused"
